lines.ruling: Ruling: representation within the selected worksheet domain; i1040gi (2025) Tax Table and Tax Computation Worksheet (SectionsA-D, first row At least$100,000) split ordinary tax at$100,000. The reply flattens filing-status and bracket guards into one choose, omits each first-row lower bound already guaranteed by the outer selector, and groups mfj/qss in SectionB.
